review:
Starlight Princess Super Scatter adds Super Scatters to Pragmatic's anime-styled tumble slot. In the base game, multiplier symbols worth up to 500x can land and are added together at the end of the tumble sequence before applying to the total win.

Four or more scatters trigger the bonus, where any multiplier landing on a winning tumble joins a running total. Triggering it with one to four Super Scatters also pays an instant 100x to 50,000x. Pragmatic lists a 96.50% RTP. It plays like Gates of Olympus Super Scatter with a different theme, and suits players who like that formula.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
